prompts.hero_ahri:
Production game SPRITE SHEET for a top-down isometric MOBA, painted crisp realistic fantasy game sprites, not pixel art. Transparent alpha background, NO grid lines, text, floor, background haze or shadows. EXACT regular grid SIX columns and TEN rows =60 cells, all equal size. Orthographic 3/4 view facing screen-right, at 35-degree downward angle, consistent body scale and anatomy across ALL frames. Each sprite COMPLETELY contained within its cell, with at least 10% transparent padding on all sides; no weapons/capes/magic may touch a neighbor. Boots ground pivot centered at 50% width, 85% height for standing poses. Body approx 60% cell height, keep scale same across rows, wider weapon swings remain within margins. Six columns are six sequential animation poses, NOT copied static illustrations. At least four substantially different silhouettes in walk and attack rows, genuine articulated limbs. TEN rows in exact order: 1 IDLE breathing and cloth sway; 2 RUN six-frame full alternating stride cycle; 3 BASIC ATTACK windup (frames1-3), contact(frame4), followthrough/recovery(frames5-6); 4 Q cast; 5 W cast; 6 E cast; 7 R cast; 8 HIT reaction/flinch/recover; 9 DEATH stagger/kneel/collapse/prone corpse; 10 RECALL channel/meditate. Spell rows show body gestures and weapon action, NOT giant effects; only tiny restrained glows, effects rendered separately by engine. Do not rotate camera or change character appearance between poses. All SIX poses in each of TEN rows must be present. Tall portrait sheet with aspect ratio 6:10, preferably 1536x2560, individual square cells. Preserve actual transparent alpha.
